title: ClientCertStore/ClientCertEntry duplicated in reader and stoa-auth
description: After the CredentialStore merge (aubi), a second identical duplication remains unaddressed: both crates/reader/src/store/client_cert_store.rs and crates/auth/src/client_cert_store.rs define ClientCertStore with the same logic. Similarly, ClientCertEntry is defined in both crates/reader/src/config.rs (line 312) and crates/auth/src/config.rs (line 21) with identical fields. The reader crate copy has an extra from_entries() alias that auth lacks, and test fixtures differ slightly. This is the same maintenance liability that motivated aubi: any fingerprint-handling bug must be fixed in two places. Follow-up epic should migrate reader to use stoa_auth::ClientCertStore and stoa_auth::ClientCertEntry, deleting the reader-local copies, exactly as was done for CredentialStore.
